summary: John's 9th-great-grandfather; born at Oberbrombach, baptized at Niederbrombach 1616.
bio:
Baptized 26 May 1616 at Niederbrombach, born at Oberbrombach; married 9 Jan 1642 at Lauterecken Elisabetha Birgert of Fockenberg-Limbach, daughter of Conrad Birgert; died 29 Apr 1671 at Berschweiler.

Round 4 read his burial entry in the Lauterecken Lutheran register ([R4-S1]). Caspar Grub, 'inhabitant' of Berschweiler, was buried there with a funeral sermon on Monday 1 May 1671. He had died early the previous morning, aged 53 years, 11 months and 3 days. The register used the Julian calendar (1 May 1671 Julian fell on a Monday), so he died on 30 Apr 1671, not 29 Apr as FamilySearch and the site have it. The stated age puts his birth at about 27 May 1617, one year later than the 26 May 1616 baptism on the site. Such ages are often a year out, so the baptism entry should be checked. FamilySearch names his parents as Christmann Grub and 'Elssa' ([R4-S2]), whereas the site gives his mother as Margaretha; see the conflict.
